# Openfolio

> {{ summary }} Openfolio Cloud is the hosted version, in an invite-only beta with a waitlist. The software is open source under the Apache-2.0 license.

Openfolio is an AI portfolio builder for students, engineers, designers, freelancers and career switchers. Visitors, usually recruiters, talk to a 3D avatar of the owner by voice or text. The avatar is always labelled as AI, answers only from a profile the owner writes and approves, and says when it doesn't know. It embeds on any website with one script tag.

## Product

- [Openfolio Cloud]({{ public_url }}/): Landing page with a live demo you can talk to, the FAQ and the waitlist
- [Full product facts]({{ public_url }}/llms-full.txt): Features, pricing, safety, technology and limits on one plain-text page

## Open source

- [Source code on GitHub]({{ github_url }}): The Openfolio voice server (Python, FastAPI, Pipecat) and embeddable widget (TypeScript, three.js), Apache-2.0
- [Self-hosting]({{ github_url }}#quick-start): Run Openfolio with Docker on a CPU-only server with your own AI providers
- [Contributing]({{ github_url }}/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): How to contribute; merged pull requests earn Openfolio Cloud credits
